caption: The drawing depicts a wrought-iron balcony attached to the corner of a building, viewed from a slightly elevated angle. The balcony features an ornate railing composed of intricate swirling and looping patterns, including spirals, curls, and circular motifs. The top of the railing has a repeating oval and cross pattern, while the body of the railing displays larger interconnected scrolls. The balcony rests on a base supported by two decorative brackets, each with their own scrollwork design. The background shows a portion of the building’s wall with light lines indicating texture, and two partially visible shuttered windows, one on either side of the corner. The entire composition uses shades of brown and black ink, giving a detailed and textured appearance, and the image is bordered by a fine, rounded rectangular frame.
title: Wrought Iron Balcony
